input.quote: 19.1 Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form. Vendor further warrants that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the fallback and substantially the preferred position. Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner (19.1, with no time limit, so well beyond the 30-day fallback and the 90-day preferred floor); Services and Deliverables must materially conform to documentation, with Deliverables warranted for ninety days after delivery or acceptance (whichever is later) and Hosted Services warranted throughout the subscription term (19.2). Vendor also warrants compliance with Applicable Law and absence of malicious code (19.3). Remedies include prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, plus termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure (19.4). The disclaimer in 19.5 expressly preserves the express warranties, so it does not hollow them out. Minor points short of the preferred wording, noted but not redlined: the non-hosted software/Deliverable conformance period is ninety days rather than 12 months, and the malicious-code warranty is qualified by "intentionally introduced by Vendor".
